class.name: WebSVGRaw
class.brief_description: An opaque fragment of SVG markup inside a [WebSVG] document.
class.description: [WebSVGRaw] holds a piece of SVG markup that the typed DOM does not model — [code]<defs>[/code], gradients, [code]<clipPath>[/code], [code]<mask>[/code], [code]<use>[/code], [code]<symbol>[/code], [code]<style>[/code], [code]<image>[/code] and filters — and emits it verbatim when the document is serialized. [WebSVG] creates these automatically while parsing, one per unmodeled element, in document order. They are what makes serializing the DOM lossless: without them, editing a single shape would discard everything else an imported document contains. The presentation properties inherited from [WebSVGElement] ([code]fill[/code], [code]stroke[/code], [code]opacity[/code] and so on) are hidden and have no effect, because [member markup] is emitted exactly as stored.

members.member: The verbatim SVG markup for this fragment, including its start and end tags and every descendant. Emitted unchanged into the rendered and exported document.
The name of the element this fragment came from, such as [code]linearGradient[/code]. Informational only; it identifies the node in the scene tree and is not used when serializing.
